title: Radio · second danger call rupture
notes: Player-caused permanent failure. Separate from the original third-room hijack.

art.caption: Field radio / return folded through the room

lines.text: Martin. It's here again. Tell me which way out.
His last four words return from the room before they return from the speaker. The walls give them back in your cadence.
Find a signed landing. Call me from— from—
A clipped return strikes the grille. The carrier folds shut, the speaker pops, and the transmit switch answers with one dead click.
